target_customer: Healthcare practices that want phone and patient access work handled by AI voice agents
problem: Practice front offices drown in phone volume, so patients wait and staff are pulled from care. Elite answers calls and completes scheduling, triage, refills and billing in the practice EHR.
business_model: Outcome-based pricing per resolved patient interaction (per the company description)
product_category: AI voice agents for healthcare front office

competitors.name: Hello Patient
competitors.what: Healthcare-only AI agents for outpatient practices across voice, text and chat

competitors.name: Hyro
competitors.what: Voice AI for large Epic-based health systems

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents are commodity, but writing back to 19 plus EHRs and encoding scheduling protocols for 18 specialties is substantial integration work for two founders.

defensibility.rationale: EHR integrations and protocol libraries add friction, but the category is crowded with similar feature lists.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known; roundups in 2026 describe a crowded market.

market_need_then: Vendor sources cite unanswered patient calls and staff overload; figures are vendor-reported and not independently verified.

branding.domain_note: Uses elitehq.ai which redirects to elitecompany.co; the legal entity is Stratum Industries Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious mission voice about rebuilding critical American industries

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a common word shared by many healthcare and legal firms, and no brand coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Elite is an active Summer 2026 company with no outcome yet. Two dropout founders target a crowded healthcare voice agent field, with one founder coming from an engineering role at a startup acquired by Legora. The company site now frames the business as a multi-industry software rebuild with healthcare coming soon, which suggests the focus may still be shifting.
notes: No funding found. Roundfunded pages are speculative reconstructions and were ignored. YC listing location differs between sources (San Francisco in directory data, New York City in a search summary). Competitor pages are vendor comparison posts, dated loosely to 2026.
